subject: Unable to install on Os X R 3.1.2

messages.author: 521ff3d3469cb28a
messages.subject: Unable to install on Os X R 3.1.2
parts:
Dear Methylkit,
I am following the instructions on the website for installation on a Mac with OS X 10.9 and R 3.1.2. It does not recognize that I have installed GenomicRanges, and complains about unavailability of the S4Vector library.
Please help,
Juan


> install_github("al2na/methylKit",build_vignettes=FALSE)
Downloading github repo al2na/methylKit@master
Installing methylKit
Installing dependencies for methylKit:
GenomicRanges, S4Vectors
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' --vanilla CMD INSTALL  \
  '/private/var/folders/v0/wvx8s8yn2yn2pw5tb3x563v40000gn/T/RtmpgJPvW5/devtools2028831b5dc/al2na-methylKit-e130672'  \
  --library='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library' --install-tests

ERROR: dependency ‘S4Vectors’ is not available for package ‘methylKit’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.1/Resources/library/methylKit’
Error: Command failed (1)
In addition: Warning message:
packages ‘GenomicRanges’, ‘S4Vectors’ are not available (for R version 3.1.2)

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Unable to install on Os X R 3.1.2
